adjudication.rationale: Looking at lines 375-381 in the diff, when `destination.credentialId` is falsy, the code falls back to filtering credentials by `destination.integration` and calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId` as the third parameter. In contrast, when `credentialId` exists (line 367), it correctly calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`. This means for destinations matched only by integration type, the `externalId` is lost, causing the created reference to have `externalCalendarId: undefined`. This would break subsequent update/delete operations that rely on this ID to address the correct calendar event.
